thread:
Maya (sales): Temposys wants a short perf POC next week. Mix: embeddings-heavy search + occasional chat generation. Requirements: sustained 300 RPS, 90s spikes to 1800 RPS, multi-AZ, private deploy with KMS. Need runbook + rough cost + security blurb.
Ethan (eng): Quick q: spike cadence and duration?
Maya (sales): Spikes ~90s every 3h, cooldown ~10m. Target SLOs: embeddings p95 <200ms, chat gen token p99 <500ms.
Priya (eng-ml): Recommend dedicated cluster, embeddings quantized 4-bit, prefix caching for chat, prewarm KV before spikes, and a lightweight fallback gen model for bursts.
Noah (eng-sre): Ops: multi-AZ active/passive adds ~25-45ms. Need burst pool and preallocated networking to avoid queuing. Also confirm KMS integration for private deploy.
Ethan (eng): Runbook draft: 1) 5m warmup to 300 RPS; 2) sustain 30m @300 RPS; 3) three spikes 90s @1800 RPS w/10m cooldown; 4) failover test. Use vegeta with traffic mix embeddings:chat = 5:1. Example: vegeta attack -rate=300 -duration=30m -targets=targets.txt | vegeta report -type=json > sustained.json
metrics-bot: Lab dry-run: sustain 300 RPS -> embeddings p95=185ms p99=310ms; gen token p95=340ms p99=520ms. Spike 1800 RPS -> embeddings p95=650ms p99=1400ms; gen token p95=980ms p99=1650ms. KV prewarm reduced spike p99 by ~36%. CSV attached.
Priya (eng-ml): Key mitigation: KV prewarm + prefix cache + fallback model keeps gen p99 closer to 700-800ms under spikes. Also quant for embeddings saves GPU memory for extra concurrency.
Noah (eng-sre): Security blurb for Temposys questionnaire: private deployment supports customer-managed keys (AWS KMS/GCP CMEK), TLS 1.2+, optional mTLS for connectors, disk encryption with customer key, audit logs exportable to customer SIEM, SOC2 and periodic penetration tests.
Maya (sales): Pricing ask: ballpark for 1-month POC with dedicated nodes + burst buffer and 3-month commit discount?
Ethan (eng): Ballpark: 8-12 A100-equivalent nodes + burst capacity ~ $40k-60k/month. 3-month commit -> ~15-22% discount typically. Final numbers from pricing team.
Maya (sales): Next steps: schedule 2-hour run (sustain + one spike + failover). Ethan to prep 1-page results with appendix (vegeta commands, prometheus queries, p95/p99 table, cost). I'll send calendar and Temposys questionnaire.
Ethan (eng): Will prepare results JSON like: {"sustained":"rps=300 p95=185 p99=310","spike":"rps=1800 p95=650 p99=1400","notes":"KV prewarm reduces p99 ~36%"} and short recommendations.
Maya (sales): Thanks team, ping me when results ready and I'll push the commercial ask. :thumbsup:
